items.text: विज्ञप्तिमात्रमेवेदमसदर्थावभासनात् यद्वत्तैमिरिकस्यासत्केशोण्ड्रकादिदर्शनम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: न देशकालनियमः संतानानियमो न च न च कृत्यक्रिया युक्ता विज्ञप्तिर्यदि नार्थतः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: देशादिनियमः सिद्धः स्वप्नवत्प्रेतवत्पुनः संतानानियमः सर्वैः पूयनद्यादिदर्शने
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: स्वप्नोपघातवत्कृत्यक्रिया नरकवत्पुनः नरकपालादिदर्शने तैश्च बाधने
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: तिरश्चां संभवः स्वर्गे यथा च नरके तथा न प्रेतानां यतस्तज्जं दुःखं नानुभवन्ति ते
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: यदि तत्कर्मभिस्तत्र भूतानां संभवस्तथा इष्यते परिणामश्च किं विज्ञानस्य नेष्यते
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: कर्मणो वासनान्यत्र फलमन्यत्र कल्प्यते तत्रैव नेष्यते यत्र वासना किं नु कारणम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: रूपाद्यायतनास्तित्वं तद्विनेयजनं प्रति अभिप्रायवशादुक्तमुपपादुकसत्त्ववत्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: नास्तीह सत्त्व आत्मा वा धर्मास्त्वेते सहेतुकाः यतः स्वबीजाद्विज्ञप्तिर्यदाभासा प्रवर्तते द्विविधायतनत्वेन ते तस्या मुनिरब्रवीत्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: तथा पुद्गलनैरात्म्यप्रवेशो हि अन्यथा पुनः देशना धर्मनैरात्म्यप्रवेशः कल्पितात्मना
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: न तदेकं न चानेकं विषयः परमाणुशः न च ते संहता यस्मात्परमाणुर्न सिध्यति
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: षट्केन युगपद्योगात्परमाणोः षडंशता षण्णां समानदेशत्वात्पिण्डः स्यादणुमात्रकः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: परमाणोरसंयोगे तत्संघातेऽस्ति कस्य सः न चानवयवत्वेन तत्संयोगान्न सिध्यति
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: दिग्भागभेदो यस्यास्ति तस्यैकत्वं न युज्यते छायावृती कथं वा अन्यो न पिण्डश्चेन्न तस्य ते
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: एकत्वे न क्रमेणेतिर्युगपन्न ग्रहाग्रहौ विच्छिन्नानेकवृत्तिश्च सूक्ष्मानीक्षा च नो भवेत्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: प्रत्यक्षबुद्धिः स्वप्नादौ यथा सा च यदा तदा न सोऽर्थो दृश्यते तस्य प्रत्यक्षत्वं कथं मतम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: उक्तं यथा तदाभासा विज्ञप्तिः स्मरणं ततः स्वप्नदृग्विषयाभावं नाप्रबुद्धो ऽवगच्छति
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: अन्योन्याधिपतित्वेन विज्ञप्तिनियमो मिथः मिद्धेनोपहतं चित्तं स्वप्ने तेनासमं फलम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: मरणं परविज्ञप्तिविशेषाद्विक्रिया यथा स्मृतिलोपादिकान्येषां पिशाचादिमनोवशात्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: कथं वा दण्डकारण्यशून्यत्वमृषिकोपतः मनोदण्डो महावद्यः कथं वा तेन सिध्यति
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: परचित्तविदां ज्ञानमयथार्थं कथं यथा स्वचित्तज्ञानमज्ञानाद्यथा बुद्धस्य गोचरः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: विज्ञप्तिमात्रतासिद्धिः स्वशक्तिसदृशी मया कृतेयं सर्वथा सा तु न चिन्त्या बुद्धगोचरः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).
